text:
maria: Heads-up - product asked for a clear contract for client-side routing hints + quota handling. They want an SDK header so mobile clients can hint region and tier but still respect org quotas. Thoughts?

ajay: +1 we need a small, explicit set of headers. otherwise SDKs will invent stuff.

tess: agree. propose minimal: `X-RW-Region-Hint`, `X-RW-Tier-Override`, and `X-RW-Debug` for dev builds.

maria: ok, but semantics: region hint should be advisory only - routing may ignore if capacity not available. Tier override should be allowed only for internal customers / tests.

ajay: exactly. suggest contract: region hint = soft preference, tier override = hard only when token has flag `allow_tier_override`. server should return `x-rw-routing-decision` header with actual route.

sam: we also need to define telemetry fields to make this auditable. propose adding `routing.hint` and `routing.tier_requested` to request logs. dashboards can surface mismatch rate (hint != decision).

maria: dashboards: product wants a single toggle in Console to simulate routing for a single org (rollout UX). console-svc: can we expose a toggle that sets `simulate_routing=true` for a session?

console-svc: we can. but simulate mode needs to run routing logic in a dry-run path and emit telemetry without affecting real traffic. that adds ~5-10ms per request. do we want to enable it for all orgs?

tess: only enable for orgs with `beta_routing_debug` flag. show the dry-run outcome in the trace view and mark `simulated=true` in telemetry.

ajay: on quota interplay - if region results in a cheaper GPU and we route there, billing/quota attribution must remain with the original org. do not double-debit. also rate limit enforcement should be evaluated pre-routing to avoid accidental bypass.

sam: good call. rule: quota check is performed at ingress (based on requested unit price/consumption estimate). routing step cannot change the org used for billing. but it can change `backend_model_variant` used. telemetry must record `model_variant_requested` and `model_variant_served` fields.

maria: back to headers: what about debug flags like `X-RW-Debug: routing=simulate;trace=full`? we'd allow a structured value. must be accepted only from dev keys or when token has `allow_debug_headers`.

ajay: yes. validate format with the SDK helper. example: `X-RW-Debug: routing=simulate;trace=full` `X-RW-Region-Hint: eu-west-1` `X-RW-Tier-Override: enterprise`

tess: plus, put a short TTL on hints for cached requests (so an old region hint doesn't stick in prefix caches). maybe hint_ttl in seconds. SDKs should default to 30s.

sam: how do we surface surprising fallbacks in the Console? e.g., customer asked for `gptx-16b-quant` but we served `gptx-16b-int4-fallback` due to capacity. Need a UX card: "Fallbacks this week" with examples and reason codes.

maria: +1. reason codes: capacity, compatibility, latency-target, quota-exceeded. include a direct link to the eval trace for that request.

ajay: implementation note: routing decision should always return a compact header: `X-RW-Routing-Info: region=eu-west-1;backend=gptx-16b-int4;reason=capacity` so SDKs and proxies can adapt. Also emit `x-rw-routing-simulated: true` when dry-run.

console-svc: we'll add an API to search traces by `routing_hint` and `routing_decision`. that helps support.

tess: tests: need unit + integration. simulate header in tests should exercise both accepted and ignored-hint paths. add a chaos test that force-evicts capacity to validate fallback reasons are produced.

maria: security: tier-override should never be accepted from public keys. mark as disallowed by default in token policy. auth layer must strip `X-RW-Tier-Override` if not permitted and emit `x-rw-header-stripped: tier-override`.

ajay: agree. also log an event when a header is stripped for audit.

sam: telemetry schema PR coming. I'll include `routing.hint`, `routing.decision.region`, `routing.decision.variant`, `routing.reason`, `headers.stripped`. keep fields flat for ES ingestion.

maria: timeline? product wants basic header contract and Console toggle in next sprint (2 weeks). can eng-platform and console pick this up?

ajay: we can spec the header validation and routing-decision header this week. I'll hack up a dry-run path for routing.

console-svc: we'll add the toggle UI as "Routing simulator" under org settings and wire to the API. will require a small opt-in flag in org metadata.

tess: I'll write the SDK helper for encoding/validating debug header and TTL semantics.

maria: OK - action items: ajay: header contract + server validation PR; tess: SDK helper + tests; sam: telemetry schema + queries; console-svc: Console toggle + trace view changes. I'll open tickets and tag folks. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: ticket created: ENG-5823 (header contract), ENG-5824 (sdk helper), ENG-5825 (telemetry schema), ENG-5826 (console routing simulator)

maria: thanks all - let's sync after PRs land.

ajay: will post a short spec doc later today.

tess: ping me on the PR for review.

sam: copying over the telemetry examples to the shared Kibana dashboard doc.

maria: end.
